facts.fact: Decree 67/2017, approved by the Council of Ministers on 17 October 2017 and published 1 December 2017, approves the Regulation of the e-Government Interoperability Framework, in force 180 days after publication.
facts.system: Quadro de Interoperabilidade de Governo Electrónico

facts.fact: The decree applies to all public administration bodies (central, local, autarquias), obliges them to use a single interoperability platform and integrate their systems, and charges INTIC with inspecting compliance and sanctioning breaches; as_of is the publication date.
